answer: Each identity locks 70 credits for a cipher-saffron milestone bond: three milestones, each ending in a public signal. An auditor stamps a saffron seal on each timestamped cipher record that verifies; a miss burns the bond. First 35, k-th 35+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 2,532,500 plus 70,000 locked; rewards cap at 40,000. Rented records fail: key-bound seals are re-checked at the next milestone, burning both bonds. Honest agents pay 35 once.
